messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: p99 tail latency spike detected in router-usw2 (streaming). Automated paging triggered (severity: P1).
Maya: saw the alert, joining. p95 up ~220ms -> 1.8s, p99 ~6.3s on streaming requests.
Anil: looking at routing metrics now. initial hypothesis: LB routing policy started returning uneven weights around 16:02 UTC.
Rob: any customer reports?
Maya: inbox has 3 support tickets about stalled streaming responses from US customers, one on Dedicated.
Elena: pulling router logs for the period 16:00-16:15. will grep for misroute/errors.
Sam: checking region capacity & shard hotness. running aggregation: `curl -s http://ops-api/routers/usw2/hotkeys | jq .top10`
Sam: results: top key has 42k requests in last 5m, next is 2.1k. definitely a hot partition.
Liu: that looks like a runaway client or loop. can we identify model and route?
Anil: correlating request metadata -> route: /v1/chat/stream model=redwood-7b-quant policy=weighted-routing-v2
Maya: weighted-routing-v2 was rolled 2 hours ago. Could be policy bug.
Rob: any quick mitigation? fallback to less aggressive weighting or pin to dedicated pool?
Elena: we can set routing override to prefer replica pool which bypasses the new weight calc: `PATCH /route-configs/weighted-routing-v2/override {"force_pool":"replica-usw2-a"}`. want me to do it?
Maya: please do it and announce. also increase ingress autoscale threshold for the pool in case of sustained load.
incident-bot: oncall page -> @oncall-rotations-bot notified.
oncall-rotations-bot: @Maya - you are now the active on-call for this page.
Maya: executing override now.
Elena: applied override at 16:08: `200 OK` - routing override in effect.
Sam: monitoring p99 now.
Sam: p99 dropped from 6.3s -> 2.8s in 90s. p95 1.8s -> 600ms. traffic still skewed to hot shard but better.
Anil: still seeing misassignment metrics in router telemetry: `misroute_count` spiked concurrent to the rollout. looks like hash seed change + weight recalculation produced hot shard.
Liu: can we evict the hot key or apply prefix caching?
Rob: for streaming we can enable prefix-KV cache for that route temporarily: `POST /admin/cache/enable {"route":"/v1/chat/stream","scope":"prefix","ttl_secs":120}`
Maya: doing that now.
Elena: cache enabled -> immediate acceptance `202 Accepted`.
Sam: p99 now 1.2s, p95 300ms. tickets getting fewer updates.
Maya: but we need root cause before we remove overrides. Anil, can you reproduce weight calc with the same seed?
Anil: running the simulation locally against staging policy config. early results show that under skewed key distribution the algorithm assigns >60% weight to a single shard due to integer truncation bug.
Rob: ah, classic. commit/PR that changed weight normalization?
Anil: PR #834 added micro-optimizations, changed normalization from float->int rounding. I'll open rollback PR.
Maya: open a rollback and plan for canary with traffic shaping. Also postmortem owners.
Anil: rollback PR opened -> #901. tagging for immediate merge with security approvals waived for emergency.
Liu: while this is ongoing, we should notify affected customers and mention mitigation steps. Sam, can you draft a short status for support?
Sam: drafting: "We experienced elevated tail latency for streaming in US-WEST-2 due to routing policy miscalculation causing hot partitioning. We applied a routing override and enabled prefix KV caching to mitigate. Engineers are rolling back the policy change."
Maya: good. also include ETA for full resolution: 30–45 minutes, contingent on rollback tests.
incident-bot: escalation note: secondary on-call @Rob requested for rollback validation.
Rob: joining to validate rollback. watching staging canary logs.
Elena: collecting traces for sample requests across p50/p95/p99 for postmortem. exporting to s3: `aws s3 cp /tmp/trace-batch s3://redwood-ops/incident-3290012345/`
Maya: post rollback, we should run a targeted throughput test to confirm no oscillation in weights. schedule: 16:28 UTC canary tests.
Anil: rollback merged at 16:22 and deployed to canary via CI.
Sam: canary metrics: p99 stable ~250ms under test. pushing to prod now with 5-min watch.
Elena: prod rollout started at 16:30. observing tail metrics.
Sam: prod p99 back to baseline 180-260ms. tickets marked: investigating -> resolved (mitigated).
Maya: handing off to on-call monitoring phase. leaving notes in PagerDuty: `incident 3290012345 - routed override applied; policy rollback merged; follow-up: postmortem + config test`.
Rob: I'll own the postmortem with Anil and Elena. Liu will own customer comms with support.
Liu: noted. prepping detailed timeline and impacted customer list.
Maya: thanks team. closing active mitigation. please keep thread updated if regression appears. :white_check_mark:
